In [[4 BBY]], the [[soldier]] was [[Death|killed]] after a [[Skirmish on Mina-Rau|skirmish]] ensued following the discovery of several undocumented [[Technician|mechanics]]. {{Char-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== The soldier appeared in the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', first appearing in the series' second episode, "[[Sagrona Teema]]," which was released on [[Disney+]] on [[April 22]], [[2025]].{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}} The soldier was portrayed by [[Alex Jordan]] and listed in the series' credits as "Soldier #1". ==Appearances== *{{Andor|Sagrona Teema}} {{1st|"[[Harvest]]"}} *{{Andor|Harvest}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=უცნობი იმპერიელი ჯარისკაცი 1 (მინა-რაუ) }} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Personnel of the Galactic Empire]]
